text: Operator pointer for synthesis-review iteration 1, given to the worker beside its unchanged packet: stages of this run disagree on one reading at Aquinas, Super Matthaeum c. 22, Venice 1745 printed p. 282 (page 5 of the retained facsimile artifact matthew-22-facsimile-d80cea1b). Research and synthesis-review 0 read 'Quae est illa vestis?'; author-study 0 and study-review 0 read 'ista'. The concise study now prints 'illa' and the accepted expansive study 'ista'. In this typeface the long-s and t ligature can resemble 'll' at low resolution. Settle the reading from a high-resolution render of the page, comparing the glyph with 'est' and 'vestis' on the same line, and treat the outcome as any other quotation check. No verdict is supplied by the driver.
